ablations.removed: POC proximity (any retest of the displacement bar range)

causality_contract.availability_rule: 60m footprint uses trades with event_ms in the trailing 60m window ending at bar close; retest touch uses bars <= close; availability_time = signal bar close

dataset_policy.allowed: certified Binance UM aggTrades day(s) + same-provenance holding data

deduplication.rule: one open position per symbol; signals while in position ignored; one pending POC retest per direction

direction: retest resolution (touch rejected back toward displacement direction -> continuation; close through POC -> no signal)

entry.rule: signal at retest-touch bar close; market fill at next bar open
entry.timing: decision_time = touch bar close; entry_time = next bar open

event_definition: Prior 60m footprint POC (max-volume $0.01 level) exists; price retests within 0.1 ATR of POC and the retest bar displaces away (range > 1x ATR14, close beyond POC in the displacement direction).
execution_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (certified channel; SL-first ambiguity; single position)
falsification: With sufficient evidence, pooled Cost-C expectancy <= 0 falsifies (FAIL).
invalidation: Retest bar closes through POC against the displacement (acceptance through the level).
mechanism: The most-traded level marks accepted value; a tested-and-rejected revisit with displacement shows renewed initiative from value.
research_question: Does a tested-and-rejected POC retest with displacement predict continuation?

stop.definition: Beyond POC level + 0.25x ATR14 on the risk side.

threshold_provenance: 60m window = one hour of trade context (domain convention). 0.1 ATR touch tolerance = frozen 11G fib-confluence convention. Displacement 1xATR = minimal impulsive bar (frozen). None fitted.
